title: Surgical AI gatekeeper with full code knowledge (replaces human approvals)
objective: ADR-0001 §5b: the end-state merge approver is a code-OMNISCIENT AI gatekeeper (not human, not blind swarm). REQUIRES full-codebase code intelligence (git kb code index / kb_callers/kb_impact, and/or RuVector) so it judges a change against its full blast radius (callers/callees/invariants), not just the diff. It is the swarm_local reviewer (HFTASK-0010) upgraded with mandatory full-code grounding. Verdict=judgment; envctl broker::decide (HFTASK-0013) is the deterministic enforcement that actually releases the token/merge. permission_gate is transitional toward THIS gatekeeper, not toward a human; remove the human approver once gatekeeper+broker are trusted.
acceptance_criteria: Surgical AI gatekeeper with full code knowledge (replaces human approvals): implemented + cargo test green + checkpointed
